question: Among users who posted comments containing a website link and have zero downvotes, what is the percentage difference in the number of 'Student' badges awarded to them between 2010 and 2011?

prediction.sql:
WITH qualified_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_010" AS user_id
    FROM comments AS c
    INNER JOIN users AS u ON c."XCL_010" = u."XCL_052"
    WHERE c."XCL_008" LIKE '%http%'
      AND u."XCL_062" = 0
),
badge_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', b."XCL_004") = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c2010,
        SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', b."XCL_004") = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c2011
    FROM badges AS b
    INNER JOIN qualified_users AS qu ON b."XCL_002" = qu.user_id
    WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Student'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN (c2010 + c2011) = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE ABS(c2010 - c2011) * 100.0 / (c2010 + c2011) 
    END AS percentage_difference
FROM badge_counts

    SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_010" AS user_id
    FROM comments AS c

),
badge_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', b."XCL_004") = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c2010,
        SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', b."XCL_004") = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c2011
    FROM badges AS b
    INNER JOIN qualified_users AS qu ON b."XCL_002" = qu.user_id

)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN (c2010 + c2011) = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE ABS(c2010 - c2011) * 100.0 / (c2010 + c2011) 
    END AS percentage_difference
FROM badge_counts

    SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_010" AS user_id
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c."XCL_008" LIKE '%http%'
      AND c."XCL_010" IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM votes v

      )
),
badge_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', b."XCL_004") = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c2010,
        SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', b."XCL_004") = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c2011
    FROM badges b
    INNER JOIN qualified_users qu ON b."XCL_002" = qu.user_id
    WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Student'
)
SELECT
